notes: Scenario director voice: every quick take and sealed check opens on one concrete, recognizable moment (a "can you talk tonight?" text, the bill landing between you, a group chat asking who can help you move), and every answer reads as a small archetype you can picture yourself doing (ate noodles for a week, a week in my cart, the notes app is full, kept checking the time). Scenes keep the "Last time..." framing so they stay did-grade evidence; imagined situations appear only in quick takes and sealed checks. Each option keeps its bank.js meaning, level and order (including the out-of-order celebration_budget, the null fairness_rule and risk_style options), and each pole gets one equally specific detail so no answer reads as the healthy one. Emotion-coded options keep their private feeling (felt bad, only ordered a salad, still think about the other, if they still liked me). No trait names, no gendered roles; the four 18+ items (commitment_pace, marriage_meaning, kids_someday, wedding_budget) are the only ones touching physical intimacy, marriage or kids. Quick-take answers are written as first-person stances rather than behaviors because they grade "prefer".
